targets.authors: Webb, S., Newton, J., & Chang, A. C. S.
targets.title: Incidental learning of collocation.
targets.evidence_quote:
This multisite study replicates Webb, Newton, and Chang’s (2013) study on the effect of
repetition on incidental learning of multiword units (MWUs).
targets.outcome_quote:
The
present study’s findings partially support the initial study. Like Webb et al., we found a
beneficial effect of repetition. This finding adds to the growing body of work on the effects of
frequency on L2 learning (Uchihara et al., 2019). However, we could not replicate the
number of encounters needed to incidentally learn MWUs, as we only found a significant

                                                31
 difference between one and more than one (5, 10, 15) occurrence.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly describe partial support: a beneficial repetition effect replicated, but the number of encounters needed did not. The conclusion confirms the repetition effect specifically, rather than offering an overall verdict that overrides the explicit contrast.

reasoning: A conceptual multisite replication tests one published original with two university samples and a secondary-school sample. These samples are not three original papers.
